Developers

The Gestalt REST API.

Authenticate, query artworks, stream audio descriptions, and manage venues programmatically.

GET /artworks List all artworks associated with a venue, with optional filtering by collection or status.
GET /artworks/:id Retrieve full metadata, description text, and audio asset URLs for a single artwork.
POST /descriptions/generate Submit an artwork image and receive a three-movement audio description generated by the Gestalt AI pipeline.
GET /venues List all venues (museums, galleries, murals) accessible to the authenticated institution account.
POST /venues/:id/audio Upload or regenerate the audio description bundle for a specific venue, triggering CDN distribution.
Full interactive API docs with authentication and live testing coming soon.
